scope: Standalone mixed-probe measurement correctness; no GPU runtime changes.

before.observed_failure: A short request could finish during prompt preparation, before the long completion call began, and the original overlap check could report a pass. Repeated runs also reused a deterministic prefix.

cases: Short request starts after the long completion call despite delayed prompt preparation
Long completion finishing before the delay cannot pass overlap
Each run gets a fresh prefix that is recorded with its settings

independent_review: Read-only review and isolated mocks also rejected preparation, long-answer validation, and short-answer failures; the real prompt builder placed the prefix before padding in tokenization and completion payloads.
limits: This verifies completion-call overlap, not server admission or prefill phase.
Live mixed tests preserve separate running-request metrics and server logs.
